For example, you might use control charts, which are graphical tools that show the range of values that are considered normal for each parameter, as well as any data points that fall outside of this range.

If you identify a deviation from normal operating conditions using SPC, you can then take action to correct the problem before it leads to a failure. For example, if you notice that the temperature of the oven is consistently too high, you might adjust the temperature control system to bring the temperature back down to the desired setpoint.

Overall, SPC is a valuable tool for detecting deviations from normal operating conditions in an industrial oven.
